title: Python ML: Percentile
description: Percentiles are used in statistics to give you a number that describes the value that a given percent of the values are lower than. For example, if we say the 75th percentile is 43, it means that 75% of the people are 43 or younger. This is widely used in data analysis to understand data distribution.
example:
# Using NumPy for Percentiles
import numpy

ages = [5,31,43,48,50,41,7,11,15,39,80,82,32,2,8,6,25,36,27,61,31]
x = numpy.percentile(ages, 75)
print(x) # Output: 43.0

challenges.title: Calculate 90th Percentile
challenges.exercise: Calculate the 90th percentile of ages = [5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50] using numpy.percentile(). Print it.
